validations.name: Check required field values
validations.statement: Reject missing values for mapped fields marked required in their effective field definitions. Do not maintain a second required setting here. The applicability mapping identifies which fields are checked.

validations.name: Check the ZIP or postal code format
validations.statement: Accept a five-digit US ZIP, ZIP+4 (nine digits, with an optional hyphen), or a Canadian postal code (A1A 1A1, with an optional space). Location inference is optional and does not determine format validity or prevent manual State / Province selection.

validations.name: Require at least one selection
validations.statement: A required checkbox-group or multi-select must contain at least one value.

validations.name: Validate available selections
validations.statement: Supplied multi-select choices must be distinct values in the effective field options.

validations.name: Validate the available selection
validations.statement: A supplied radio or select value must occur in the effective field options.

validations.name: Validate the authored field length
validations.statement: Check the maximum length supplied by the effective field definition; do not maintain a second limit here.

validations.name: Validate an email address
validations.statement: Use the shared email-format check for fields with email format.

validations.name: Validate a phone number
validations.statement: Use the shared ten-digit check for fields with phone format.

validations.name: Validate an SSN
validations.statement: Use the shared nine-digit check for fields with SSN format.

validations.name: Validate a percentage format
validations.statement: Use the shared up-to-three-digit check for percentage fields.

validations.name: Validate a month and year
validations.statement: Use the shared MM/YYYY format check with a valid month and a four-digit year.

validations.name: Validate a nonnegative number
validations.statement: Use the effective field definition to decide whether decimals are permitted; reject negative or malformed numbers.

validations.name: Validate the authored minimum field length
validations.statement: Check the minimum length supplied by the effective field definition. Empty optional answers remain allowed; requiredness is checked separately.

validations.name: Validate digits-only text
validations.statement: Fields with digits format accept digits only and retain leading zeroes. Format and length are selected by the effective field definition; membership identifiers can remain unrestricted text for other Sites.
